subject.title: [Bug]: Hundreds of repeated HTTP requests to 169.254.169.254:80 for the first 10 minutes after the startup

question: Is the linked PR's targeted source-run proof enough for this auth-provider compatibility fix, or should it wait for live no-signal sandbox and explicit AWS default-chain validation before merge?
rationale: The remaining blocker is maintainer risk tolerance around AWS credential probing behavior, not a missing source-level root cause.

options.title: Require live credential proof
options.body: Ask for or run one no-signal sandbox/log proof plus one explicit Bedrock default-chain proof such as AWS_PROFILE or EC2/ECS before merge.

options.title: Accept source-backed proof
options.body: Merge the linked PR after exact-head CI if maintainers accept the SDK contract proof and focused tests as sufficient for this limited fix.

options.title: Choose a different compatibility boundary
options.body: Keep the issue open and request a different patch shape if implicit IMDS probing must remain available for more auto-detection cases.

recommendation.title: Require live credential proof
recommendation.body: Ask for or run one no-signal sandbox/log proof plus one explicit Bedrock default-chain proof such as AWS_PROFILE or EC2/ECS before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Most closely connected to the current Bedrock memory adapter boundary and prior credential-gate fix history.
